title: Combined mass bound for the slice of a represented current and the slice of its boundary
statement: Assume (SL), the frozen statement of dimred_mbl_slice_mass_bounds (verbatim the fourth hypothesis of the parent's Lean statement): for all P, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), measures μ, μ' on ℝ^P finite on compact subsets of U, fields ξ of (k+1)-vectors and ξ' of k-vectors, a.e. strongly measurable for μ resp. μ', such that for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every covector α, and for μ'-a.e. x, |ξ'(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every covector α (|α| the Euclidean covector norm), T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U) and ∂T(η) = ∫ξ'(η)dμ' for all η ∈ 𝒟^k(U), and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ (L ∈ ℝ≥0), there are A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η ∩ {f = t} = ∅, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for every open W and t, and ∫_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t) dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for every open W and a, b ∈ ℝ. Let P, d ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), μ, μ' measures on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ and μ'(K) < ∞ for every compact K, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{d+1}(ℝ^P) and ξ' : ℝ^P → Λ_d(ℝ^P) a.e. strongly measurable for μ resp. μ' such that for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every covector α, and likewise for ξ', μ', X(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{d+1}(ℝ^P), ∂X(η) = ∫ξ'(η)dμ' for every η ∈ 𝒟^d(ℝ^P), and f : ℝ^P → ℝ L-Lipschitz with L ∈ ℝ≥0. Then there are A_t ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) and B_t ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω)dμ and B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η)dμ' for all t and all test forms, such that for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P and every t ∈ ℝ, with Z_t := ∂A_t − B_t, M_W(Z_t) + boundaryMassOn(Z_t, W) ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} h⁻¹(μ + μ')(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}). Here boundaryMassOn(Z_t, W) = 0 if d = 0 and = M_W(∂Z_t) if d ≥ 1, h⁻¹ stands for ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹, and all quantities lie in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (A : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (B : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ (t : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1)), A t ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), B t η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), Disjoint (tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) {x | f x = t} → (A t).boundary η = B t η) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen W → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}))) → ∀ (P d : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, X.boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (A : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ (t : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)), A t ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), B t η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W + boundaryMassOn ((A t).boundary - B t) W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * (μ + μ') (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0))
